remarks: Beautifully renovated and turnkey, this spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers 860 square feet of modern living on the top (5th) floor, the highest level in the building, showcasing expansive city views of Stamford. Thoughtfully updated throughout, the open-concept layout features a bright and airy living space filled with natural light, a modern kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a seamless flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The generously sized bedroom and updated bathroom complete the interior. A standout feature is the full-size in-unit laundry room, offering both convenience and additional storage. Step out onto the private balcony to enjoy sweeping, unobstructed views, the perfect place to unwind. This unit includes one assigned covered parking space and is ideally located in the heart of Springdale, just moments from local shops, restaurants, and only a few blocks to the train station for an easy commute. Move-in ready and offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience, this is one not to miss.
